svg.title: Web app on Azure
svg.desc: Web app on Azure. 10 components in 5 groups. Connections: Users to Azure Front Door (HTTPS); Azure Front Door to App Service; App Service to Integration interface (VNet integration); Integration interface to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Azure SQL Database (Private Link); Integration interface to Private endpoint; Private endpoint to Key Vault (Private Link); Integration interface to Private DNS zones (name resolution); Application Insights to App Service.

text.tspan: Front Door sends traffic to App Service, which reaches Azure SQL and Key Vault through private endpoints
